title: The cutoff archive-root probe reads the archive root as a literal path
description: The cutoff archive-root probe reads the archive root as a literal path
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-145 and SPEED-1.a.3 require a cutoff without an archive root to read as absent and only an unreadable archive tree to be an error; a project directory beginning with pathspec magic made the fallback probe fail and report could not be read (#990)
acceptance_criteria: for a project in a directory named :(exclude)app whose trusted cutoff has no archive root, the cutoff-tree check answers from the cutoff's own tree instead of reporting that the archive tree could not be read; an unreadable cutoff archive tree is still an error
